Description - GET /services/ChomikBoxService.svc

Not used by the client. GET on the .svc (also ?wsdl, ?singleWsdl) returns the WCF help page saying metadata publishing is disabled, so there is no WSDL; the contract in this document was derived from the client's requests and the deserialisation oracle.

Path notes

The real URL every SOAP operation is posted to. Documented here for service-level behaviour; the per-operation paths (/Auth, /Folders, …) describe the operations themselves.

Security notes - findings that concern GET /services/ChomikBoxService.svc

  • S-07 Low Contract disclosure through faults and headers: a:DeserializationFailed names parameters and CLR types, a:DestinationUnreachable leaks internal origin host names, and responses carry x-powered-by: ASP.NET and x-server.

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
